rows.speaker: Cotset
rows.en: M-Miss...! The Hyakki Empire is... coming...
rows.display_text:
「M-Miss...! The Hyakki Empire is...
coming...」

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: What a pathetic voice! Put some strength in your gut!
rows.display_text:
「What a pathetic voice! Put some
strength in your gut!」

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: ...I'd like to say that, but I'm... in pretty bad shape myself...
rows.display_text:
「...I'd like to say that, but I'm... in
pretty bad shape myself...」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: If they struck at a moment like this, there's no doubt the Hyakki Empire is the one who's been cutting off our food supply lines.
rows.display_text:
「If they struck now, the Hyakki Empire's
clearly behind our cut food supply lines.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Then let's smash them and make them realize everything they've done was for nothing!
rows.display_text:
「Then let's smash them and make them
realize everything they've done was for
nothing!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Easy for you to say...
rows.display_text: 「Easy for you to say...」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: No good...! I can't get my body to move!
rows.display_text:
「No good...! I can't get my body to
move!」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: You can't fight a war on an empty stomach... This time it's seriously bad.
rows.display_text:
「You can't fight a war on an empty
stomach... This time it's seriously bad.」

rows.speaker: Sirius
rows.en: How pathetic...! To be toyed with by a scheme like this!
rows.display_text:
「How pathetic...! To be toyed with by a
scheme like this!」

rows.speaker: Sirius
rows.en: I absolutely refuse to accept this...! I will not be defeated by hunger!
rows.display_text:
「I absolutely refuse to accept this...! I
will not be defeated by hunger!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: A samurai keeps his toothpick even when he hasn't eaten... is that it.
rows.display_text:
「A samurai keeps his toothpick even
when he hasn't eaten... is that it.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: That's a fine sentiment, but...
rows.display_text: 「That's a fine sentiment, but...」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: We're not samurai, so that's not gonna work for us!
rows.display_text:
「We're not samurai, so that's not gonna
work for us!」

rows.speaker: Marin
rows.en: It galls me, but this round goes to them...!
rows.display_text:
「It galls me, but this round goes to
them...!」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: Screw it, I'm past caring! Let's squeeze out what's left of our strength!!
rows.display_text:
「Screw it, I'm past caring! Let's squeeze
out what's left of our strength!!」

rows.speaker: Chill
rows.en: It's no use...! There's nothing left to squeeze out!
rows.display_text:
「It's no use...! There's nothing left to
squeeze out!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Like this... can we even... fight...?
rows.display_text: 「Like this... can we even... fight...?」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: Damn it...! I'm so hungry!!
rows.display_text: 「Damn it...! I'm so hungry!!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: N-No good...! There's no way we can win like this!
rows.display_text:
「N-No good...! There's no way we can win
like this!」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: Don't talk weak, Renton! Dig deep and find your will...
rows.display_text:
「Don't talk weak, Renton! Dig deep and
find your will...」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: Ngh...!

rows.speaker: Gura
rows.en: Hahahahaha! How pitiful, Getter Robo!
rows.display_text: 「Hahahahaha! How pitiful, Getter Robo!」

rows.speaker: Tekkouki
rows.en: That voice -- Dr. Gura!
rows.display_text: 「That voice -- Dr. Gura!」

rows.speaker: Gura
rows.en: That's right, Tekkouki. Have you learned to fear the food-rotting nanomachines I developed!?
rows.display_text:
「That's right, Tekkouki. Have you learned
to fear the food-rotting nanomachines I
developed!?」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Damn it! Did you come here just to laugh at us while we're starving!?
rows.display_text:
「Damn it! Did you come here just to
laugh at us while we're starving!?」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: Get out here! Face us head-on!!
rows.display_text: 「Get out here! Face us head-on!!」

rows.speaker: Gura
rows.en: I'm afraid not. This Mecha Yosaiki also serves as the nanomachines' control system.
rows.display_text:
「I'm afraid not. This Mecha Yosaiki also
serves as the nanomachines' control
system.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: Then if we defeat the demon doctor...
rows.display_text: 「Then if we defeat the demon doctor...」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: We can exterminate the little pest that's been spoiling our food too!
rows.display_text:
「We can exterminate the little pest
that's been spoiling our food too!」

rows.speaker: Gura
rows.en: Quite right. But can you defeat an enemy you cannot see?
rows.display_text:
「Quite right. But can you defeat an
enemy you cannot see?」

rows.speaker: Gura
rows.en: The Mecha Yosaiki's stealth is perfect. No method will let you find it.
rows.display_text:
「The Mecha Yosaiki's stealth is perfect.
No method will let you find it.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Then all we can do is spray fire everywhere and hope for a lucky hit!!
rows.display_text:
「Then all we can do is spray fire
everywhere and hope for a lucky hit!!」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: That's reckless, $n! It's far too inefficient!!
rows.display_text:
「That's reckless, $n! It's far too
inefficient!!」

rows.speaker: Duke
rows.en: Besides, in our current state, a tactic like that would just wear us out...
rows.display_text:
「Besides, in our current state, a tactic
like that would just wear us out...」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: Is there no other option...?
rows.display_text: 「Is there no other option...?」

rows.speaker: Gura
rows.en: Hahahahaha, $c! Despair before your own hunger!
rows.display_text:
「Hahahahaha, $c! Despair before your
own hunger!」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: I-I can't take it anymore... I'm so hungry... my mind's going dark...
rows.display_text:
「I-I can't take it anymore... I'm so
hungry... my mind's going dark...」

rows.speaker: Pala
rows.en: If I'd known it would come to this... I never should have dieted... I should've eaten until I was full...
rows.display_text:
「If I'd known it'd come to this... I
never should've dieted... I should've eaten
till I was full...」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: N-No...! I don't want to die like this, starving...!
rows.display_text:
「N-No...! I don't want to die like this,
starving...!」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: It can't be helped... We'll fall back once and regroup.
rows.display_text:
「It can't be helped... We'll fall back
once and regroup.」

rows.speaker: Orson
rows.en: But if we don't break the enemy's strategy, we'll eventually starve to death.
rows.display_text:
「But if we don't break the enemy's
strategy, we'll eventually starve to
death.」

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: Even so, we're at our limit! We can't fight like this!
rows.display_text:
「Even so, we're at our limit! We can't
fight like this!」

rows.speaker: Fudo
rows.en: Hunger comes from the desire to eat.
rows.display_text: 「Hunger comes from the desire to eat.」

rows.speaker: Jun
rows.en: Huh...?

rows.speaker: Pierre
rows.en: Is now really the time to state the obvious!?
rows.display_text:
「Is now really the time to state the
obvious!?」

rows.speaker: Fudo
rows.en: Being hungry and being famished are not the same.
rows.display_text:
「Being hungry and being famished are not
the same.」

rows.speaker: Reika
rows.en: Huh...?

rows.speaker: Fudo
rows.en: When you come to know the 'emptiness' within your own belly... true power will emerge!
rows.display_text:
「When you come to know the 'emptiness'
within your own belly... true power will
emerge!」

rows.speaker: Oliver
rows.en: What's that guy even talking about...?
rows.display_text: 「What's that guy even talking about...?」

rows.speaker: Raita
rows.en: How should I know!? I'm too hungry to even think!
rows.display_text:
「How should I know!? I'm too hungry to
even think!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Hungry and famished... hungry and famished...
rows.display_text:
「Hungry and famished... hungry and
famished...」

rows.speaker: Jun
rows.en: The power of hunger... that's it!
rows.display_text: 「The power of hunger... that's it!」

rows.speaker: Jun
rows.en: Since ancient times, when people fast, their consciousness awakens and their senses grow sharper...!
rows.display_text:
「Since ancient times, when people fast,
their consciousness awakens and their
senses grow sharper...!」

rows.speaker: Pierre
rows.en: Sharpened senses... food...? I get it, it's the smell!
rows.display_text:
「Sharpened senses... food...? I get it,
it's the smell!」

rows.speaker: Sirius
rows.en: Apollo, listen! Search for the smell!
rows.display_text: 「Apollo, listen! Search for the smell!」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: Smell...?
rows.display_text: 「Smell...?」

rows.speaker: Sirius
rows.en: That's right. The demons of the Hyakki Empire are living beings too. They consume food...!
rows.display_text:
「That's right. The demons of the Hyakki
Empire are living beings too. They consume
food...!」

rows.speaker: Sirius
rows.en: If it's their mothership, it should naturally be carrying food as well!
rows.display_text:
「If it's their mothership, it should
naturally be carrying food as well!」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: All right...!
rows.display_text: 「All right...!」

rows.speaker: Sirius
rows.en: Silvia, let's focus our minds too! We'll lend Apollo our strength!
rows.display_text:
「Silvia, let's focus our minds too! We'll
lend Apollo our strength!」

rows.speaker: Tsugumi
rows.en: Wait, please! That's...
rows.display_text: 「Wait, please! That's...」

rows.speaker: Reika
rows.en: We'll do it too!
rows.display_text: 「We'll do it too!」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: Right!
rows.display_text: 「Right!」

rows.speaker: Rena
rows.en: Those three... they've gone a day longer without food than Apollo or Sirius...
rows.display_text:
「Those three... they've gone a day
longer without food than Apollo or
Sirius...」

rows.speaker: Rena
rows.en: That means... they'll bring out even more power.
rows.display_text:
「That means... they'll bring out even
more power.」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: Let's do this, Reika, Tsugumi!
rows.display_text: 「Let's do this, Reika, Tsugumi!」

rows.speaker: Reika
rows.en: Right!
rows.display_text: 「Right!」

rows.speaker: Tsugumi
rows.en: Please, Apollo!
rows.display_text: 「Please, Apollo!」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: Sniff sniff... sniff sniff sniff!
rows.display_text: 「Sniff sniff... sniff sniff sniff!」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: Got it!
rows.display_text: 「Got it!」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: There!!
rows.display_text: 「There!!」

rows.speaker: Sirius
rows.en: Go, Silvia!!
rows.display_text: 「Go, Silvia!!」

rows.speaker: Gura
rows.en: I-Impossible! How was my stealth broken!?
rows.display_text:
「I-Impossible! How was my stealth
broken!?」

rows.speaker: Tekkouki
rows.en: So this is the power of humanity's -- no, all life's -- primal instinct... the power of appetite!
rows.display_text:
「So this is the power of humanity's --
no, all life's -- primal instinct... the
power of appetite!」

rows.speaker: Duke
rows.en: Well done, Aquarion!!
rows.display_text: 「Well done, Aquarion!!」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Now all we have to do is take him down and everything's fine!
rows.display_text:
「Now all we have to do is take him down
and everything's fine!」

rows.speaker: Gura
rows.en: Enough! Don't think you can beat this Mecha Yosaiki!
rows.display_text:
「Enough! Don't think you can beat this
Mecha Yosaiki!」

rows.speaker: Gura
rows.en: Besides, what can you possibly do in that starved state!?
rows.display_text:
「Besides, what can you possibly do in
that starved state!?」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: T-True enough...
rows.display_text: 「T-True enough...」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: But if we win this fight, we get to eat!
rows.display_text:
「But if we win this fight, we get to
eat!」

rows.speaker: Fudo
rows.en: Then let me give you all some words.
rows.display_text: 「Then let me give you all some words.」

rows.speaker: Fudo
rows.en: Hunger is the best spice!
rows.display_text: 「Hunger is the best spice!」

rows.speaker: Marin
rows.en: Hunger is...
rows.display_text: 「Hunger is...」

rows.speaker: Stoner
rows.en: ...the best spice...
rows.display_text: 「...the best spice...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Words to live by.
rows.display_text: 「Words to live by.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Let's do this, everyone! Win, and the best meal of our lives is waiting!
rows.display_text:
「Let's do this, everyone! Win, and the
best meal of our lives is waiting!」

rows.speaker: Gura
rows.en: W-What is this intensity!?
rows.display_text: 「W-What is this intensity!?」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: This is the power of our instincts!!
rows.display_text: 「This is the power of our instincts!!」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: Whoaaa! I'll eat it all! I'll devour every last bit!!
rows.display_text:
「Whoaaa! I'll eat it all! I'll devour every
last bit!!」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: This is for our food! Get ready!!
rows.display_text: 「This is for our food! Get ready!!」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: We did it! A come-from-behind win!!
rows.display_text: 「We did it! A come-from-behind win!!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Finally, we get to eat!!
rows.display_text: 「Finally, we get to eat!!」

rows.speaker: Fudo
rows.en: Well done. Here's a small gift of congratulations from me.
rows.display_text:
「Well done. Here's a small gift of
congratulations from me.」

rows.speaker: Fudo
rows.en: It's a DEAVA transport plane. It's loaded to the brim with food.
rows.display_text:
「It's a DEAVA transport plane. It's
loaded to the brim with food.」

rows.speaker: Reika
rows.en: F-Food...!
rows.display_text: 「F-Food...!」

rows.speaker: Tsugumi
rows.en: It's here!!
rows.display_text: 「It's here!!」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: Thank you, Commander!
rows.display_text: 「Thank you, Commander!」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: If you had food this whole time, you could've just brought it out from the start...
rows.display_text:
「If you had food this whole time, you
could've just brought it out from the
start...」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: No matter how starving we are, you're one old man we're not gonna eat.
rows.display_text:
「No matter how starving we are, you're
one old man we're not gonna eat.」

rows.speaker: Fudo
rows.en: Heh... I'll leave it there.
rows.display_text: 「Heh... I'll leave it there.」

rows.speaker: Gura
rows.en: Damn it! I had $c cornered, just one step away!
rows.display_text:
「Damn it! I had $c cornered, just one
step away!」

rows.speaker: Gura
rows.en: Fall back! Next time won't go so easily!!
rows.display_text:
「Fall back! Next time won't go so
easily!!」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Just wait, Tiffa! I'll definitely beat them and get you a full meal!
rows.display_text:
「Just wait, Tiffa! I'll definitely beat
them and get you a full meal!」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Wait, 'get you a meal'? That makes me sound like a husband!
rows.display_text:
「Wait, 'get you a meal'? That makes me
sound like a husband!」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: Whoaaa! I'm gonna eat! I'll devour it all!!
rows.display_text:
「Whoaaa! I'm gonna eat! I'll devour it
all!!」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: Lizards, snakes, natto, all of it! I'll even eat the demons!!
rows.display_text:
「Lizards, snakes, natto, all of it! I'll
even eat the demons!!」

rows.speaker: Chill
rows.en: C-Calm down, Jiron! If you eat one of those, its horns will get stuck in your throat!!
rows.display_text:
「C-Calm down, Jiron! If you eat one of
those, its horns will get stuck in your
throat!!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: How dare you torment Sara! Her figure was almost reduced to skin and bones!
rows.display_text:
「How dare you torment Sara! Her figure
was almost reduced to skin and bones!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Unforgivable! For the sake of Sara's lovely body, I will absolutely defeat you!!
rows.display_text:
「Unforgivable! For the sake of Sara's
lovely body, I will absolutely defeat you!!」

rows.speaker: Duke
rows.en: Not just us, but starving the people of Tresor Institute and the surrounding area too...!
rows.display_text:
「Not just us, but starving the people of
Tresor Institute and the surrounding area
too...!」

rows.speaker: Duke
rows.en: Here we come, Hyakki Empire! Feel the wrath of humanity's most basic instincts!
rows.display_text:
「Here we come, Hyakki Empire! Feel the
wrath of humanity's most basic instincts!」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: Hyakki Empire! Your cowardly tactics end here!
rows.display_text:
「Hyakki Empire! Your cowardly tactics
end here!」

rows.speaker: Hayato
rows.en: We're plenty angry today. Call it a case of hunger that just won't quiet down.
rows.display_text:
「We're plenty angry today. Call it a
case of hunger that just won't quiet
down.」

rows.speaker: Benkei
rows.en: Go, Ryo! Make them pay for every scrap of food they rotted!!
rows.display_text:
「Go, Ryo! Make them pay for every scrap
of food they rotted!!」

rows.speaker: Marin
rows.en: When I came to Earth, I met the blessings of natural food for the first time, and I was grateful for how wonderful it was.
rows.display_text:
「When I first came to Earth and tasted
nature's bounty of food, I was grateful
for how wonderful it was.」

rows.speaker: Marin
rows.en: You made it rot -- for that, I'll crush you thoroughly!!
rows.display_text:
「You made it rot -- for that, I'll crush
you thoroughly!!」

rows.speaker: Tsugumi
rows.en: How dare you... how dare you pull something so vile as stealing our food!
rows.display_text:
「How dare you... how dare you pull
something so vile as stealing our food!」

rows.speaker: Reika
rows.en: We fight for the sake of food! I won't forgive anyone who takes it from us!
rows.display_text:
「We fight for the sake of food! I won't
forgive anyone who takes it from us!」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: To live is to eat! Long live food!!
rows.display_text: 「To live is to eat! Long live food!!」

rows.speaker: Sirius
rows.en: S-Silvia...
rows.display_text: 「S-Silvia...」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: Ain't nothing wrong with that. She's not wrong.
rows.display_text:
「Ain't nothing wrong with that. She's
not wrong.」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: Here I come, demons! Anyone who wastes food is gonna get pounded by me!!
rows.display_text:
「Here I come, demons! Anyone who wastes
food is gonna get pounded by me!!」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Did you know, mister demon? The ultimate pleasure for girls is good food and sweets.
rows.display_text:
「Did you know, mister demon? The
ultimate pleasure for girls is good food
and sweets.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: For taking that away, I, Kei Katsuragi, will punish you!
rows.display_text:
「For taking that away, I, Kei Katsuragi,
will punish you!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Thanks to you, the convenience store's sales tanked, and Talho took it out on me!
rows.display_text:
「Thanks to you, the convenience store's
sales tanked, and Talho took it out on
me!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Get ready! This attack is payment for all that ruined pizza and chicken!!
rows.display_text:
「Get ready! This attack is payment for
all that ruined pizza and chicken!!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Even between enemies, intruding on one's daily life like this is the height of bad taste.
rows.display_text:
「Even between enemies, intruding on
one's daily life like this is the height of
bad taste.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I don't care for direct violence...
rows.display_text: 「I don't care for direct violence...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: But if you're going to interfere with my private meals, you'll answer for it accordingly!
rows.display_text:
「But if you're going to interfere with
my private meals, you'll answer for it
accordingly!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Did you know, demon? Eighty-eight gods live in a single grain of rice!
rows.display_text:
「Did you know, demon? Eighty-eight gods
live in a single grain of rice!」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: The grains of rice you've spoiled are more than anyone could count!
rows.display_text:
「The grains of rice you've spoiled are
more than anyone could count!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: So that's how it is! On behalf of all those countless gods, I'm gonna knock you flat!
rows.display_text:
「So that's how it is! On behalf of all
those countless gods, I'm gonna knock you
flat!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Anyone who disrespects food like that can go reflect on it in the next world!!
rows.display_text:
「Anyone who disrespects food like that
can go reflect on it in the next world!!」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: ...How's the Nirvash's overhaul coming along, Renton?
rows.display_text:
「...How's the Nirvash's overhaul coming
along, Renton?」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: They say they're starting over from the design stage. Dr. Bear's helping out too, and they're pushing ahead at full speed.
rows.display_text:
「They're redoing it from the design
stage. Dr. Bear's helping too, and they're
pushing ahead at full speed.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: But I heard even if they rush, it'll take about two weeks.
rows.display_text:
「But I heard even if they rush, it'll
take about two weeks.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: That's taking a while. Orson's Orguss was already put back together.
rows.display_text:
「That's taking a while. Orson's Orguss
was already put back together.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Until then, I guess we'll just have to keep relying on Tresor Institute's hospitality.
rows.display_text:
「Until then, I guess we'll just have to
keep relying on Tresor Institute's
hospitality.」

rows.speaker: Marin
rows.en: The fight with the Argama and the Minerva left every unit with serious damage. We need to get those repaired too.
rows.display_text:
「The fight with the Argama and Minerva
left every unit badly damaged. Those need
repairs too.」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: And the Archangel and the Freedom are still unaccounted for...
rows.display_text:
「And the Archangel and the Freedom are
still unaccounted for...」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: We haven't received any information about what happened to them since.
rows.display_text:
「We haven't received any information
about what happened to them since.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: With the chaos from the New Earth Federation's coup, it seems neither the Federation nor ZAFT has time to spare for them.
rows.display_text:
「Amid the New Earth Federation's coup,
neither the Federation nor ZAFT can
spare time for them.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: There's a lot I want to ask them. I just hope they're safe...
rows.display_text:
「There's a lot I want to ask them. I
just hope they're safe...」

rows.speaker: Daisuke
rows.en: They're people who made up their minds to fight against the whole world.
rows.display_text:
「They're people who made up their minds
to fight against the whole world.」

rows.speaker: Daisuke
rows.en: People with strong will don't lose... For now, all we can do is believe in that.
rows.display_text:
「People with strong will don't lose... For
now, all we can do is believe in that.」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: ...No use thinking about it. Let's just get some food for now.
rows.display_text:
「...No use thinking about it. Let's just
get some food for now.」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: The director here talks too much, but I'll give this place credit -- the food's great.
rows.display_text:
「The director here talks too much, but
I'll give this place credit -- the food's
great.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Even so, you guys are seriously overeating...!
rows.display_text:
「Even so, you guys are seriously
overeating...!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: 'A guest holds back quietly by the third bowl'... That saying clearly doesn't apply to them.
rows.display_text:
「'A guest holds back quietly by the
third bowl'... That saying clearly doesn't
apply to them.」

rows.speaker: Tsugumi
rows.en: Food, food~! Time to dig in!
rows.display_text: 「Food, food~! Time to dig in!」

rows.speaker: Reika
rows.en: You really do eat like everything's delicious, Tsugumi.
rows.display_text:
「You really do eat like everything's
delicious, Tsugumi.」

rows.speaker: Tsugumi
rows.en: Huh...? Senpai, is it just a vegetable salad for you today?
rows.display_text:
「Huh...? Senpai, is it just a vegetable
salad for you today?」

rows.speaker: Reika
rows.en: Y-Yeah...
rows.display_text: 「Y-Yeah...」

rows.speaker: Tsugumi
rows.en: You're not dieting or anything, are you? I mean, you already have a great figure, Senpai.
rows.display_text:
「You're not dieting or anything, are
you? I mean, you already have a great
figure, Senpai.」

rows.speaker: Reika
rows.en: W-Well... this morning when I got on the scale, I'd gained nine hundred grams...
rows.display_text:
「W-Well... this morning when I got on
the scale, I'd gained nine hundred grams...」

rows.speaker: Tsugumi
rows.en: Huh!? I'm too scared to even get on a scale!
rows.display_text:
「Huh!? I'm too scared to even get on a
scale!」

rows.speaker: Reika
rows.en: Weight control is part of training too. If the relationship between body and mind falls out of sync...
rows.display_text:
「Weight control is part of training too.
If body and mind fall out of sync...」

rows.speaker: Reika
rows.en: ...Aquarion's fusion sense dulls, and depending on the situation, it could be fatal...
rows.display_text:
「...Aquarion's fusion sense dulls, and
depending on the situation, it could be
fatal...」

rows.speaker: Tsugumi
rows.en: F-Fatal...!
rows.display_text: 「F-Fatal...!」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: What are you two making a fuss about in the mess hall?
rows.display_text:
「What are you two making a fuss about
in the mess hall?」

rows.speaker: Tsugumi
rows.en: Oh... Silvia...
rows.display_text: 「Oh... Silvia...」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: What's this, Reika... dieting? Suddenly cutting back on food like that is bad for you, you know~
rows.display_text:
「What's this, Reika... dieting? Suddenly
cutting back on food like that is bad for
you, you know~」

rows.speaker: Reika
rows.en: ...I know that much.
rows.display_text: 「...I know that much.」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: Scary, scary. Your eyes are glaring daggers at the food.
rows.display_text:
「Scary, scary. Your eyes are glaring
daggers at the food.」

rows.speaker: Reika
rows.en: Wha--!

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: Sorry, but I'm eating without holding back. Dig innn~!
rows.display_text:
「Sorry, but I'm eating without holding
back. Dig innn~!」

rows.speaker: Rena
rows.en: ...I can see it now. A princess, stuffed full and blown up round...
rows.display_text:
「...I can see it now. A princess, stuffed
full and blown up round...」

rows.speaker: Rena
rows.en: A pitiful fate, abandoned by her beloved big brother...
rows.display_text:
「A pitiful fate, abandoned by her
beloved big brother...」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: Ah... aah... no way!
rows.display_text: 「Ah... aah... no way!」

rows.speaker: Maai
rows.en: It's okay, Silvia...! There's still time!
rows.display_text: 「It's okay, Silvia...! There's still time!」

rows.speaker: Gidget
rows.en: Don't give up... Our battle starts right now.
rows.display_text:
「Don't give up... Our battle starts right
now.」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: Everyone...
rows.display_text: 「Everyone...」

rows.speaker: Mimsy
rows.en: Maybe because the food here is so good, but all of us... have put on weight.
rows.display_text:
「Maybe because the food here is so
good, but all of us... have put on weight.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Down with flab! Away with the pudgy belly and the thick thighs!
rows.display_text:
「Down with flab! Away with the pudgy
belly and the thick thighs!」

rows.speaker: Michiru
rows.en: Even if it's hard, if we all encourage each other, I'm sure we can get through it.
rows.display_text:
「Even if it's hard, if we all encourage
each other, I'm sure we can get through
it.」

rows.speaker: Toniya
rows.en: Announcement to all female personnel. Starting now, we're gathering every last ounce of strength and carrying out Operation Diet.
rows.display_text:
「Announcement to all female personnel:
starting now, we're gathering every last
ounce of strength for Operation Diet.」

rows.speaker: Tsugumi
rows.en: Yes!
rows.display_text: 「Yes!」

rows.speaker: Reika
rows.en: Understood. I swear to give it everything I've got.
rows.display_text:
「Understood. I swear to give it
everything I've got.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: Diet Squad, ei, ei, oh!!
rows.display_text: 「Diet Squad, ei, ei, oh!!」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: Oh!!

rows.speaker: Reika
rows.en: Focus... focus. Clear the mind, and even hunger can't touch you...
rows.display_text:
（Focus... focus. Clear the mind, and even
hunger can't touch you...）

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: Soft-serve... fried chicken... oh... pizza sounds good too...
rows.display_text:
（Soft-serve... fried chicken... oh... pizza
sounds good too...）

rows.speaker: Tsugumi
rows.en: I want to swim in a sea of chocolate... then drown in a sea of whipped cream, and then a sea of pudding...
rows.display_text:
（I want to swim in a sea of chocolate...
then drown in seas of whipped cream and
pudding...）

rows.speaker: Hikaru
rows.en: I want to eat toast topped with cheese made from freshly squeezed milk...
rows.display_text:
（I want to eat toast topped with cheese
made from freshly squeezed milk...）

rows.speaker: Michiru
rows.en: Gunma's famous konjac is low-calorie, so maybe it'd be okay to eat...
rows.display_text:
（Gunma's famous konjac is low-calorie,
so maybe it'd be okay to eat...）

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: Ahh... that sukiyaki I had in Yapan was so good...
rows.display_text:
（Ahh... that sukiyaki I had in Yapan was
so good...）

rows.speaker: Pala
rows.en: Hold on... hold on. I'll definitely show Ennil up...
rows.display_text:
（Hold on... hold on. I'll definitely show
Ennil up...）

rows.speaker: Toniya
rows.en: Ngh... I'm the one who started this, so there's no way I can be the first to drop out...
rows.display_text:
（Ngh... I'm the one who started this, so
there's no way I can be the first to
drop out...）

rows.speaker: Jamie
rows.en: I wonder if the girls back on Planet S-1 used to diet too...
rows.display_text:
（I wonder if the girls back on Planet
S-1 used to diet too...）

rows.speaker: Maai
rows.en: I can't lose to Lieea...
rows.display_text: （I can't lose to Lieea...）

rows.speaker: Lieea
rows.en: I can't lose to Maai...
rows.display_text: （I can't lose to Maai...）

rows.speaker: Mimsy
rows.en: I'll be eighteen soon too... I'm going to be at my most beautiful before that day comes...
rows.display_text:
（I'll be eighteen soon too... I'm going to
be at my most beautiful before that day
comes...）

rows.speaker: Gidget
rows.en: Standing next to Eureka just makes my chub stand out more...
rows.display_text:
（Standing next to Eureka just makes my
chub stand out more...）

rows.speaker: Daisuke
rows.en: Amazing... all the women are dieting together, huh...
rows.display_text:
「Amazing... all the women are dieting
together, huh...」

rows.speaker: Talho
rows.en: Watch your mouth, Daisuke. Some of us don't need anything like that.
rows.display_text:
「Watch your mouth, Daisuke. Some of us
don't need anything like that.」

rows.speaker: Daisuke
rows.en: R-Right...
rows.display_text: 「R-Right...」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: That's right. Only sloppy little kids need something like that.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. Only sloppy little kids
need something like that.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: That's certainly true. It's because they can't discipline themselves that they end up in a state like this.
rows.display_text:
「That's certainly true. It's because they
can't discipline themselves that they end
up like this.」

rows.speaker: Ennil
rows.en: Heh... those girls must have forgotten they're women.
rows.display_text:
「Heh... those girls must have forgotten
they're women.」

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en: You're all so harsh. Let's be kind and watch over them like grown women, shall we?
rows.display_text:
「You're all so harsh. Let's be kind and
watch over them like grown women, shall
we?」

rows.speaker: Chill
rows.en: Hey, Hilda... what's a diet?
rows.display_text: 「Hey, Hilda... what's a diet?」

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en: Simply put, it's not eating in order to lose weight.
rows.display_text:
「Simply put, it's not eating in order to
lose weight.」

rows.speaker: Maetel
rows.en: If you do that, you'll just get hungry! That's ridiculous!
rows.display_text:
「If you do that, you'll just get hungry!
That's ridiculous!」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: That won't do, Maetel. For a young woman, beauty is a very important matter.
rows.display_text:
「That won't do, Maetel. For a young
woman, beauty is a very important matter.」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: That said, we're still growing, so let's make sure to eat properly.
rows.display_text:
「That said, we're still growing, so let's
make sure to eat properly.」

rows.speaker: Mischa
rows.en: Speaking as a doctor too, I agree with Princess Ana.
rows.display_text:
「Speaking as a doctor too, I agree with
Princess Ana.」

rows.speaker: Chill
rows.en: I'm all for it too! So let's have a snack!
rows.display_text:
「I'm all for it too! So let's have a
snack!」

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: It's kind of sad for Silvia and the others... not being able to eat cookies this good.
rows.display_text:
「It's kind of sad for Silvia and the
others... not being able to eat cookies
this good.」

rows.speaker: Rag
rows.en: Eh... just let them do it. Once they're really hungry, they'll feel silly and quit.
rows.display_text:
「Eh... just let them do it. Once they're
really hungry, they'll feel silly and quit.」

rows.speaker: Shaya
rows.en: Heheh... being a girl is tough. I already dropped out, so I can take it easy.
rows.display_text:
「Heheh... being a girl is tough. I already
dropped out, so I can take it easy.」

rows.speaker: Papty
rows.en: I don't think there's anything to worry about, but please make sure you eat properly, Talho.
rows.display_text:
「I don't think there's anything to worry
about, but please make sure you eat
properly, Talho.」

rows.speaker: Talho
rows.en: I know. Thanks, Papty.
rows.display_text: 「I know. Thanks, Papty.」

rows.speaker: Mome
rows.en: Lady Tiffa, aren't you dieting?
rows.display_text: 「Lady Tiffa, aren't you dieting?」

rows.speaker: Tiffa
rows.en: Um, yeah...
rows.display_text: 「Um, yeah...」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: You're too light... you should eat more.
rows.display_text: 「You're too light... you should eat more.」

rows.speaker: Tiffa
rows.en: I think so too, but... I just can't eat very much...
rows.display_text:
「I think so too, but... I just can't eat
very much...」

rows.speaker: Tiffa
rows.en: I really do wish I could gain a little more weight...
rows.display_text:
「I really do wish I could gain a little
more weight...」

rows.speaker: Rena
rows.en: If the diet squad heard that, they'd probably cry and get furious.
rows.display_text:
「If the diet squad heard that, they'd
probably cry and get furious.」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: What about you, then?
rows.display_text: 「What about you, then?」

rows.speaker: Rena
rows.en: Heh... it seems I take in nutrients a little differently from normal people.
rows.display_text:
「Heh... it seems I take in nutrients a
little differently from normal people.」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: Then what about you?
rows.display_text: 「Then what about you?」

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: I... don't seem to gain weight no matter what I eat.
rows.display_text:
「I... don't seem to gain weight no
matter what I eat.」

rows.speaker: Rena
rows.en: Well then, let's have tea, just the members here.
rows.display_text:
「Well then, let's have tea, just the
members here.」

rows.speaker: Rena
rows.en: There are a lot of us who can't eat much, so the tea snacks will probably be left over today anyway.
rows.display_text:
「There are a lot of us who can't eat
much, so the tea snacks will probably be
left over today anyway.」

rows.speaker: Pierre
rows.en: Still, is it really something to fuss over that much? Girls look cute with a little softness to them.
rows.display_text:
「Still, is it really something to fuss
over that much? Girls look cute with a
bit of softness.」

rows.speaker: Sirius
rows.en: It can't be helped. It's in pursuit of perfect beauty.
rows.display_text:
「It can't be helped. It's in pursuit of
perfect beauty.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Besides, that's just male logic. Girls always want to make themselves look more beautiful, no matter what.
rows.display_text:
「Besides, that's just male logic. Girls
always want to look more beautiful, no
matter what.」

rows.speaker: Roybea
rows.en: On top of that, a lot of girls are taking part in this one.
rows.display_text:
「On top of that, a lot of girls are
taking part in this one.」

rows.speaker: Roybea
rows.en: It's less about the eyes of men and more that they're being judged so harshly by each other -- that makes it hard to just quit.
rows.display_text:
「It's less about men's eyes and more
that they judge each other so harshly --
that's what makes quitting so hard.」

rows.speaker: Witz
rows.en: Huh... so whoever drops out gets branded a loser, then.
rows.display_text:
「Huh... so whoever drops out gets
branded a loser, then.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Well... it's only the first day. Surely nobody's already--
rows.display_text:
「Well... it's only the first day. Surely
nobody's already--」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Darling... I'm so hungry... help me...
rows.display_text: 「Darling... I'm so hungry... help me...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: There's one right here!
rows.display_text: 「There's one right here!」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: That won't do, Mel! What happened to escaping that pudgy tummy!?
rows.display_text:
「That won't do, Mel! What happened to
escaping that pudgy tummy!?」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: But... they say when you lose weight, it comes off your chest first...
rows.display_text:
「But... they say when you lose weight,
it comes off your chest first...」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: It's fine for Tsugumi, Michiru, and Pala, but me... if I lose any more, I'll go into negative numbers...
rows.display_text:
「It's fine for Tsugumi, Michiru, and Pala,
but me... if I lose any more, I'll go into
negative numbers...」

rows.speaker: Hayato
rows.en: Now that's a problem.
rows.display_text: 「Now that's a problem.」

rows.speaker: Pierre
rows.en: If it comes to that, you've got it completely backwards! Everyone, wake up!
rows.display_text:
「If it comes to that, you've got it
completely backwards! Everyone, wake up!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: This is bad, Hilda!
rows.display_text: 「This is bad, Hilda!」

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en: What's wrong, Renton? Are you done stocking the shelves at the store already?
rows.display_text:
「What's wrong, Renton? Are you done
stocking the shelves at the store
already?」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: W-Well...! No food supplies are coming in at all!
rows.display_text:
「W-Well...! No food supplies are coming in
at all!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Tresor Institute's food stores are about to run completely empty!
rows.display_text:
「Tresor Institute's food stores are
about to run completely empty!」

rows.speaker: Benkei
rows.en: What did you say!?
rows.display_text: 「What did you say!?」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: Our food supplies aren't being restocked...? What in the world is going on...
rows.display_text:
「Our food supplies aren't being
restocked...? What in the world is going
on...」

rows.speaker: Shilha
rows.en: ...Are you watching how the wingless ones live, Futaba?
rows.display_text:
「...Are you watching how the wingless
ones live, Futaba?」

rows.speaker: Futaba
rows.en: Yeah... but they're really disgusting, aren't they...
rows.display_text:
「Yeah... but they're really disgusting,
aren't they...」

rows.speaker: Futaba
rows.en: Using their sacred mouths just to eat things.
rows.display_text:
「Using their sacred mouths just to eat
things.」

rows.speaker: Shilha
rows.en: Futaba... that is the cursed fate of the wingless ones...
rows.display_text:
「Futaba... that is the cursed fate of
the wingless ones...」

rows.speaker: Shilha
rows.en: From the moment they're born into this world until the day they die, they must devour the bodies of birds and fish and beasts, of green grass and fruit -- feeding on life just to survive.
rows.display_text:
「From birth to death they must devour
birds, fish, beasts, grass, and fruit --
feeding on life just to survive.」

rows.speaker: Futaba
rows.en: Hmph... and here the sacred mouth exists to breathe in the spirit of the air and sing the words of the stars.
rows.display_text:
「Hmph... and the sacred mouth exists to
breathe in the air's spirit and sing the
stars' words.」

rows.speaker: Shilha
rows.en: And now, it seems the demons are moving against those wingless ones...
rows.display_text:
「And now, it seems the demons are
moving against those wingless ones...」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Nanomachines?
rows.display_text: 「Nanomachines?」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: According to Morita, whatever infiltrated Tresor Institute and rotted every scrap of stored food was its doing.
rows.display_text:
「According to Morita, whatever
infiltrated Tresor Institute and rotted all
our stored food was its doing.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: It even worked its way into sealed containers and vacuum packs, real thorough about it.
rows.display_text:
「It even worked its way into sealed
containers and vacuum packs, real
thorough about it.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Thanks to that thing, the food inside this facility is completely wiped out...
rows.display_text:
「Thanks to that thing, the food inside
this facility is completely wiped out...」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: On top of that, the whole surrounding area's been attacked by someone, and the supply line here's been cut off completely.
rows.display_text:
「On top of that, someone's attacked the
whole surrounding area, cutting off our
supply line here completely.」

rows.speaker: Shaya
rows.en: Even if we buy food, it just rots again right away. We're completely at a loss.
rows.display_text:
「Even if we buy food, it just rots again
right away. We're completely at a loss.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: It's already been five days since the food ran out. Those with less stamina are starting to lose the ability to move.
rows.display_text:
「It's already been five days since the
food ran out. Those with less stamina are
starting to lose mobility.」

rows.speaker: Tex
rows.en: Man does not live by bread alone... but it's also true that without bread -- without food -- we can't live at all.
rows.display_text:
「Man does not live by bread alone... but
without bread -- without food -- we
can't live at all, either.」

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: How did things end up like this...?
rows.display_text: 「How did things end up like this...?」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Someone's out there working to crush us, I'd guess.
rows.display_text:
「Someone's out there working to crush
us, I'd guess.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: So what, then...! Whoever it is is just waiting for us to starve to death!?
rows.display_text:
「So what, then...! Whoever it is is just
waiting for us to starve to death!?」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: I doubt they're being that leisurely about it. They'll strike once our strength has dropped enough.
rows.display_text:
「I doubt they're being that leisurely
about it. They'll strike once our strength
has dropped enough.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: That time's coming soon...
rows.display_text: 「That time's coming soon...」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Everyone, look! Apollo's eating something!
rows.display_text:
「Everyone, look! Apollo's eating
something!」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: Did you find some food!? If you did, share it!
rows.display_text:
「Did you find some food!? If you did,
share it!」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: Nah, that's not it... I'm just sucking on a pebble to take my mind off things.
rows.display_text:
「Nah, that's not it... I'm just sucking on
a pebble to take my mind off things.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: I'm starving out of my mind, but even I can't eat rocks...
rows.display_text:
「I'm starving out of my mind, but even I
can't eat rocks...」

rows.speaker: Benkei
rows.en: If we leave the institute, there's gotta be food out there somewhere. Let's go, everyone.
rows.display_text:
「If we leave the institute, there's gotta
be food out there somewhere. Let's go,
everyone.」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: Calm down, Benkei. If we do that, wherever we go next will just end up in the same state as here.
rows.display_text:
「Calm down, Benkei. If we do that,
wherever we go next will just end up in
the same state as here.」

rows.speaker: Hayato
rows.en: Captain Jamil and the others know that too, which is why they're not moving.
rows.display_text:
「Captain Jamil and the others know that
too, which is why they're not moving.」

rows.speaker: Sirius
rows.en: This won't end unless we defeat the enemy stealing our food, will it...
rows.display_text:
「This won't end unless we defeat the
enemy stealing our food, will it...」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: I don't know who's behind this, but they'd better hurry up and attack already...! Then I'll turn it right back on them!
rows.display_text:
「Whoever's behind this better hurry up
and attack already...! Then I'll turn it
right back on them!」

rows.speaker: Fudo
rows.en: Can you manage that, the way you are now?
rows.display_text:
「Can you manage that, the way you are
now?」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: Whoa!
rows.display_text: 「Whoa!」

rows.speaker: Jun
rows.en: Commander Fudo...! You were here!
rows.display_text: 「Commander Fudo...! You were here!」

rows.speaker: Fudo
rows.en: I only just arrived.
rows.display_text: 「I only just arrived.」

rows.speaker: Chill
rows.en: Hey, mister... you don't happen to have any food, do you?
rows.display_text:
「Hey, mister... you don't happen to have
any food, do you?」

rows.speaker: Rag
rows.en: At this point, natto, anything, just give us some food.
rows.display_text:
「At this point, natto, anything, just
give us some food.」

rows.speaker: Fudo
rows.en: No.
rows.display_text: 「No.」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: Then what the hell did you come here for!? If it's something pointless, you won't get off easy!
rows.display_text:
「Then what the hell did you come here
for!? If it's something pointless, you
won't get off easy!」

rows.speaker: Fudo
rows.en: Heh... on edge from hunger, are you. How small.
rows.display_text:
「Heh... on edge from hunger, are you.
How small.」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: Wha--
rows.display_text: 「Wha--」

rows.speaker: Fudo
rows.en: I'm not the one you should be fighting. ...It's coming.
rows.display_text:
「I'm not the one you should be fighting.
...It's coming.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: This is bad, everyone! The demons are attacking!
rows.display_text:
「This is bad, everyone! The demons are
attacking!」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: So it was the Hyakki Empire starving us out!
rows.display_text:
「So it was the Hyakki Empire starving us
out!」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: This is for our food! Everyone, let's launch!!
rows.display_text:
「This is for our food! Everyone, let's
launch!!」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: You demon bastards...! I'll pay you back in full for messing with our food!
rows.display_text:
「You demon bastards...! I'll pay you back
in full for messing with our food!」

rows.speaker: Fudo
rows.en: Heh...

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: Well then...
rows.display_text: 「Well then...」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: Time to eat!!
rows.display_text: 「Time to eat!!」

rows.speaker: Hikaru
rows.en: It's delicious...! This meal is so good it's bringing tears to my eyes...
rows.display_text:
「It's delicious...! This meal is so good
it's bringing tears to my eyes...」

rows.speaker: Daisuke
rows.en: Hunger is the best spice, huh... That couldn't be more true.
rows.display_text:
「Hunger is the best spice, huh... That
couldn't be more true.」

rows.speaker: Marin
rows.en: And Earth's natural blessings give us the strength to live.
rows.display_text:
「And Earth's natural blessings give us
the strength to live.」

rows.speaker: Daisuke
rows.en: That's right. We should never forget to be grateful for all our food.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. We should never forget to
be grateful for all our food.」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: What, Daisuke. If you don't want it, I'll take that meat.
rows.display_text:
「What, Daisuke. If you don't want it, I'll
take that meat.」

rows.speaker: Daisuke
rows.en: Not a chance, Apollo. This one's mine.
rows.display_text: 「Not a chance, Apollo. This one's mine.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Guess even the Little Prince turns into a starving beast today.
rows.display_text:
「Guess even the Little Prince turns into
a starving beast today.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: You know, snide remarks don't really land when you've got sauce on the corner of your mouth.
rows.display_text:
「You know, snide remarks don't really
land when you've got sauce on the corner
of your mouth.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Well, look who's got cream on the tip of her nose.
rows.display_text:
「Well, look who's got cream on the tip
of her nose.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Eating well, Gain?
rows.display_text: 「Eating well, Gain?」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Yeah, well. Even you seem to be more about food than booze today.
rows.display_text:
「Yeah, well. Even you seem to be more
about food than booze today.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Not really. Good food just makes the drink go down easier.
rows.display_text:
「Not really. Good food just makes the
drink go down easier.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Booze, food, booze, food, booze, food -- the perfect combo! Then a last plate to finish it off! Doesn't get better than this!
rows.display_text:
「Booze, food, booze, food, booze, food
-- perfect combo! One last plate to top
it off! Nothing beats this!」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Couldn't agree more. Here's to good food and the sweet wine of victory.
rows.display_text:
「Couldn't agree more. Here's to good
food and the sweet wine of victory.」

rows.speaker: Pala
rows.en: It's good... this is so good! I've never had meat this delicious before!
rows.display_text:
「It's good... this is so good! I've never
had meat this delicious before!」

rows.speaker: Chill
rows.en: Sis Pala... that's lizard meat, you know.
rows.display_text: 「Sis Pala... that's lizard meat, you know.」

rows.speaker: Pala
rows.en: Huh...

rows.speaker: Pala
rows.en: But I don't care! If it's this good, I'll eat lizard, snake, whatever!!
rows.display_text:
「But I don't care! If it's this good, I'll
eat lizard, snake, whatever!!」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: This whole-roasted one's good too. Try it.
rows.display_text:
「This whole-roasted one's good too. Try
it.」

rows.speaker: Pala
rows.en: Anything's fine by me now! Ahh, eating is just wonderful!
rows.display_text:
「Anything's fine by me now! Ahh, eating
is just wonderful!」

rows.speaker: Ennil
rows.en: Heh... guess it's still appetite over vanity for her.
rows.display_text:
「Heh... guess it's still appetite over
vanity for her.」

rows.speaker: Raita
rows.en: Renton! More fried chicken over here!
rows.display_text: 「Renton! More fried chicken over here!」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: Pizza for me! And don't forget the Tabasco!
rows.display_text:
「Pizza for me! And don't forget the
Tabasco!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Hold on a second! At this rate I won't get a chance to eat myself!
rows.display_text:
「Hold on a second! At this rate I won't
get a chance to eat myself!」

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: Renton, here...
rows.display_text: 「Renton, here...」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: A sandwich...! Did you... did you make this, Eureka?
rows.display_text:
「A sandwich...! Did you... did you make
this, Eureka?」

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: This way you can eat even while you're moving around.
rows.display_text:
「This way you can eat even while you're
moving around.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Oh, thanks! I'm... gonna keep this forever!
rows.display_text:
「Oh, thanks! I'm... gonna keep this
forever!」

rows.speaker: Benkei
rows.en: Hey, Renton! Is that hot dog ready yet!?
rows.display_text:
「Hey, Renton! Is that hot dog ready
yet!?」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Coming right up! I'm... gonna give it my all!
rows.display_text:
「Coming right up! I'm... gonna give it my
all!」

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: Ah... Renton...
rows.display_text: 「Ah... Renton...」

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: I went to all that trouble making it, and it's pointless if you don't eat it...
rows.display_text:
「I went to all that trouble making it,
and it's pointless if you don't eat it...」

rows.speaker: Rena
rows.en: Heh... guess his stomach and head are empty, but his heart's full.
rows.display_text:
「Heh... guess his stomach and head are
empty, but his heart's full.」

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en: Still, I bet this whole ordeal taught everyone to appreciate food a little more.
rows.display_text:
「Still, I bet this whole ordeal taught
everyone to appreciate food a little more.」

rows.speaker: Mischa
rows.en: This should put an end to that reckless dieting fuss too.
rows.display_text:
「This should put an end to that reckless
dieting fuss too.」

rows.speaker: Rena
rows.en: I wonder about that...
rows.display_text: 「I wonder about that...」

rows.speaker: Mischa
rows.en: What do you mean?
rows.display_text: 「What do you mean?」

rows.speaker: Rena
rows.en: Heh... you'll see soon enough. Just watch those three -- they're off in their own little world...
rows.display_text:
「Heh... you'll see soon enough. Just
watch those three -- they're off in
their own little world...」

rows.speaker: Reika
rows.en: This is happiness...! This is what happiness feels like! My tongue and my stomach are both singing...!
rows.display_text:
「This is happiness...! This is what
happiness feels like! My tongue and my
stomach are both singing...!」

rows.speaker: Tsugumi
rows.en: Ohh... I'm about to explode from how delicious this is!!
rows.display_text:
「Ohh... I'm about to explode from how
delicious this is!!」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: Food is the best! Sweets are paradise! Long live us foodies!!
rows.display_text:
「Food is the best! Sweets are paradise!
Long live us foodies!!」

rows.speaker: Tsugumi
rows.en: Kyaaaaaaaaaa!!
rows.display_text: 「Kyaaaaaaaaaa!!」

rows.speaker: Reika
rows.en: No way... this can't be happening...!?
rows.display_text: 「No way... this can't be happening...!?」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: Why...!? I lost weight from fasting, but it's all back after just one day...!
rows.display_text:
「Why...!? I lost weight from fasting, but
it's all back after just one day...!」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: If anything, I've gained even more than before!!
rows.display_text:
「If anything, I've gained even more than
before!!」

rows.speaker: Ennil
rows.en: Oh my... that's rebound weight gain for you.
rows.display_text:
「Oh my... that's rebound weight gain for
you.」

rows.speaker: Tsugumi
rows.en: Rebound!?
rows.display_text: 「Rebound!?」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: It seems like fasting made your bodies absorb nutrients better than usual.
rows.display_text:
「It seems like fasting made your bodies
absorb nutrients better than usual.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: So if you binge eat in that state, you gain weight more easily than normal, which means your weight ends up higher than it was before.
rows.display_text:
「Binge eating in that state makes you
gain weight more easily, so you end up
heavier than before.」

rows.speaker: Reika
rows.en: T-That can't be...
rows.display_text: 「T-That can't be...」

rows.speaker: Tsugumi
rows.en: After going through all that suffering, and we end up fatter anyway...
rows.display_text:
「After going through all that suffering,
and we end up fatter anyway...」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: Ah... ahaha... ahahaha... what even was the point... of our whole week...
rows.display_text:
「Ah... ahaha... ahahaha... what even was
the point... of our whole week...」
